provenance: Numerical fixtures authored for audited sandbox plant verification; no supplier, CAD assembly, hardware identification or vehicle selection is represented.

frame_contract.body: FRD; axes fixed to central structure
frame_contract.quaternion: scalar-first Hamilton q_LB; R_LB maps B to L
frame_contract.euler: named roll, pitch, yaw in rad; Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll)
frame_contract.gimbal: R_BM=Rx(alpha)Ry(beta); outer body-fixed x, inner carried y
frame_contract.spin_sign_reference: common +z_M, not an unspecified visual CW/CCW convention

mass_properties.provenance: Synthetic constant complete-body mass and full inertia; not measured vehicle data.
limitations: Frozen rigid-body fixture; rotor and joint relative momentum are explicitly omitted.
Actuator-response tests with this frozen mass model are numerical tests, not complete articulated-vehicle dynamics.
No vehicle ledger, structural acceptance or hardware mass reconciliation is represented.

geometry.provenance: Synthetic intersecting-axis coaxial geometry; not selected pivot location, rotor spacing, lever arm or clearance evidence.

lag_parameters.provenance: Synthetic motor lag and cascaded gimbal-filter parameters; no hardware calibration or loaded actuator capability.
limitations: Speed-command abstraction, not an ESC PWM or motor electrical model.
Prescribed response without joint-load feedback, backlash, friction, compliance or thermal dynamics.
Joint, cone, rate and acceleration values are test inputs only.

environment.electrical_model: Prescribed constant terminal voltage, SOC and temperatures; no dynamic battery closure.
environment.nonpropulsive_load_model: Explicitly omitted aerodynamic, wake-on-structure, contact and disturbance loads in the base analytical fixture.
environment.provenance: Synthetic environment inputs, not a verified operating envelope.
limitations: Calm ambient air does not establish absence of rotor-wake or rotational aerodynamic loads.
No cylindrical aerodynamic model is imported or substituted for the exposed structure.
Fixed SOC and temperatures cannot establish endurance or continuous thermal feasibility.
Hub positions must be supplied from the actual instantaneous plant evaluation, not fixed here.

synthetic_paired_map.formula: For i in {upper,lower}, j is the other rotor; d_i=1+chi_i*(abs(omega_j)/omega_ref)^2; T_i=kT_i*omega_i^2/d_i; Q_i=kQ_i*omega_i^2/d_i.
synthetic_paired_map.electrical_formula: I_motor_i=I_idle_i+Q_i/Kt_i; I_bus_i=I_idle_i+Q_i*abs(omega_i)/(efficiency_i*V_bus). Quasi-steady arithmetic only; not a motor voltage/duty or acceleration-current solution.
synthetic_paired_map.provenance: Invented analytical functions for testing paired evaluation and signed external-load plumbing; NOT vendor performance data or calibrated coaxial losses.
limitations: The synthetic functions ignore inflow, density, spacing and thermal effects despite receiving those interface inputs.
All physical operating-domain flags remain unresolved in the base fixture.
Currents exclude rotor kinetic-energy transients and cannot establish electrical feasibility.
Equal coefficients permit an independent closed-form trim fixture; real counter-rotating rotors need not have equal thrust or torque.

solver.note: Output sampling and maximum ODE step are not PID control cadence. No controller executes.

spherical_free_rotation.note: Explicitly override propulsion and nonpropulsive loads to zero; constant body omega gives independent Hamilton exponential orientation and ballistic CG translation.

trim.formula: For identical coefficients, identity attitude, zero rates and zero gimbal: omega_trim^2=m*g/(2*kT-m*g*chi/omega_ref^2). Require positive denominator and admissible fixture speeds. Opposite signs and equal Q balance axial torque.
trim.note: Compute speed from actual configuration inputs. Do not store a fabricated measured trim result. No closed-loop hover or mission test is represented.

momentum_balance.note: Instantaneous algebraic interface fixture, not a dynamically consistent vehicle joint trajectory. Use prescribed_internal_momentum mode explicitly.

offset_kinematics.note: Prescribed instantaneous kinematic fixture for hub velocities and fixed-datum conversion; not accepted moving-mass vehicle data.

CAD_conversion.note: Synthetic full tensor and points for unit/rotation tests; not measurements from any CAD artifact.

analytical_test_tolerances.status: proposed numerical regression thresholds; not human-agreed vehicle acceptance limits

unperformed_vehicle_work: Calibrated coaxial propulsion, electrical and thermal operating domains.
CAD-derived complete installed mass, configuration-dependent CG and full inertia.
Rotor and joint momentum, loaded actuator capability and multibody-model error bounds.
PID implementation, tuning, attitude recovery, tracking and saturation-recovery acceptance.
Takeoff, 300-second hover, landing, touchdown and mission energy acceptance.
Hardware, structural, flight and safety validation.
